name: Z-phase as an H-box
summary: A Z-spider with phase α is a phase-free Z-spider with an arity-1 H-box labelled $e^{iα}$ attached.
description:
A Z-spider with phase $\alpha$ equals a phase-free Z-spider with an extra leg, plugged by the arity-1 H-box with label $e^{i\alpha}$ (the state $|0\rangle + e^{i\alpha}|1\rangle$). This is how ZX-diagrams are translated into ZH-diagrams: the ZH-calculus only has phase-free Z-spiders, and puts all phases into H-box labels.

With [Hadamard as an H-box](../zh-hadamard-as-h-box/) this gives a translation of every ZX-diagram into the ZH-calculus.

source.location: Section 2.1, translation of the green spider
